Are vegan diets healthy for dogs?

Vegan diets can be healthy for dogs if the diet is nutritionally complete and balanced, meets AAFCO standards, and is overseen by a veterinarian. Large-scale studies and surveys report that dogs fed nutritionally sound vegan diets show fewer health disorders and vet visits than those on conventional meat-based diets, with some studies noting ideal body condition and normal health markers. Experts caution that unsupervised or improperly formulated vegan diets can lack essential nutrients and pose risks, and that puppies and dogs with certain conditions may not be suitable candidates. Overall, the evidence indicates that vegan diets are not inherently unhealthy for dogs when properly designed and monitored, but outcomes depend on formulation and veterinary guidance [d1,d5,d6,d11,d12,d13,d14].
